propositions: Comment density audit of 95-file reconciler subtree identified 10 files carrying either 'RELOCATED VERBATIM' markers (6 occurrences, all in adapters/jira_datacenter) or module-size-cap references (6 occurrences in transport.py, retry.py, transitions.py), with corrected baseline of ~12 occurrences, not the initially claimed 28.

Stale comments documented as factual stubs (e.g., '_backend_registry.py:3' claiming 'signatures pinned, bodies to be implemented') are contradicted by live imports of select_backend across 13 modules and must be corrected or deleted.

Four new ADRs consolidating redundantly-restated arguments (field-convergence fit-then-normalize at 8 sites; pagination-stall aborts past fail-open handlers at 3 sites with 3 prior incidents; unmapped relations skipped not approximated; core owns value maps) plus amendments to ADRs 0028/0055/0031/0035 must be created BEFORE comments citing them are collapsed or deleted.

The do_not_move list (~25 entries, 110 pragma lines) capturing measured external-API facts and anti-refactor warnings must be appended to .joe-janitor/tools.md before any edit lands, ensuring load-bearing invariants are not lost during relocation.
